binding_requirements.RC-0011: Kullanıcı doğum yeri seçtiğinde koordinat ile zaman dilimi ayrı ayrı doğrulanacak.
binding_requirements.RC-0012: Aynı şehir ismine sahip farklı ülkelerdeki şehirlerin birbirine karışması engellenecek.

runtime_contract.coordinate_timezone_independence: coordinates and IANA timezone are distinct required fields; neither may be inferred from the other at runtime selection time
runtime_contract.same_name_policy: same-name city records remain distinct by stable id and visibly disambiguated by admin area/country; search must not collapse them

validation.timezone: non-empty IANA id, dataset release gate validates packaged ids

promotion_policy: Machine evidence may promote RC-0011 and RC-0012 to TESTED. VERIFIED/DONE require end-to-end birth-place selection UI/runtime evidence against the physically bundled city dataset.
